spec.title: Go-To-Market Launch Readiness Assessment — Orion Analytics Suite 3.2
spec.subtitle: Ref: LRA-3784696 | Date: 18 September 2026 | From: Commercial Strategy Office

sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.body: This assessment confirms that all primary go-to-market workstreams for Orion Analytics Suite 3.2 have met launch criteria for the scheduled release on 5 October 2026. Cross-functional sign-offs have been obtained from Pricing, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Customer Support, and Legal. Residual risks have been identified, quantified, and assigned mitigation owners. Overall readiness score is 92%, exceeding the 85% threshold required for executive launch approval.

sections.heading: Pricing and Packaging Readiness
sections.body: The revised tiered subscription model (Core, Professional, and Enterprise Plus) has been finalized with margin targets of 68%, 72%, and 75% respectively. Discount guardrails and deal desk approval workflows are configured within Salesforce, and regional price lists have been validated for North America, EMEA, and APAC. A sensitivity analysis indicates a potential 3–5% variance in first-quarter ARR due to competitive discounting in the mid-market segment; mitigation includes pre-approved promotional bundles expiring 31 December 2026.

sections.heading: Positioning and Messaging Validation
sections.body: Product Marketing has completed external message testing with 24 beta customers and two analyst briefings, resulting in refinement of the primary value proposition around "predictive operational visibility." Updated messaging pillars and competitive battlecards were distributed to Sales on 9 September 2026. Website, launch webinar deck, and press materials are aligned to the finalized narrative, with embargoed press outreach coordinated through BrightLine PR.

sections.heading: Sales Enablement and Channel Preparedness
sections.body: All quota-carrying representatives (n=143) completed mandatory launch certification, with an average assessment score of 88%. Enablement assets include updated demo scripts, ROI calculators, objection-handling guides, and vertical-specific case studies for logistics and manufacturing segments. Channel partners have received pricing briefs and joint marketing kits; 11 of 13 strategic partners have confirmed launch-day promotional activities. Remaining partner alignment is tracked with weekly follow-up through 30 September 2026.

sections.heading: Support, Operations, and Legal Clearance
sections.body: Tier 1 and Tier 2 support teams completed technical training modules, and knowledge base articles (KB-3201 through KB-3224) are published in the customer portal. Infrastructure stress testing indicates system stability at 1.8x projected peak load, with monitoring dashboards configured for real-time incident response. Legal has cleared updated terms of service, data processing addendum, and export compliance review, including GDPR and UK Data Protection Act alignment. No open critical compliance issues remain; minor contractual language refinements are scheduled for inclusion in the November documentation update.

spec.footer_note: Confidential — Internal Distribution Only | Page 1 of 2
